sources.title: NY Giants practice report: Dominic Zvada’s 62-yard field goal wins the day
sources.description: EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. — If he wasn’t already, undrafted free agent Dominic Zvada on Wednesday stamped himself as the clear favorite to win the placekicking competition against second-year kicker Ben Sauls. Zvada ended Wednesday’s practice with a 62-yard gamep-winning field goal in a tie game, final play of the game situation. That capped a day […]
